Root reviewed the closed86/2 transition leaf and exact installed ed1daf0bf engine source. _flow_observed_contact invokes _flow_dispatch_contact.call_deferred from the real native overlap; the dispatch assertion requires !Engine.is_in_physics_frame. Godot SceneTree.physics_process flushes MessageQueue after callbacks at scene_tree.cpp613, while Main keeps _in_physics true until main.cpp4682. Therefore call_deferred can still execute during physics, even after public Pause; this source-proven phase assumption is invalid. The original conjunct does not establish a Hero position/clock mismatch because individual operands were not logged.

Keep the genuine overlap receipt, same source/Hero identity, public request_pause and all exact state assertions. In this TEST-only dispatch await one actual process_frame while the Tree remains paused before evaluating the outside-physics assertion, then verify the pause drain/menu/campaign_error, coherent capture and exact recorded Hero pose/clock before public request_contact_exit. Print each conjunct if it still fails. Do not merely drop the phase/clock/pose check or change production Shell/contact/codec/strict-terminal state. Preserve original86/2 with401 frozen inputs and scope; rerun only the affected transition leaf. No full-route/earned-exit gate or missing shared API is indicated.

Primary exact source inspected: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ed1daf0bf001b61586d9930840f2f1394092c079/scene/main/scene_tree.cpp#L596-L624 and https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/ed1daf0bf001b61586d9930840f2f1394092c079/main/main.cpp#L4617-L4682 .
